name: Golden Visa (E28)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least USD 350,000 (5-year visa) or USD 700,000 (10-year visa) placed in Indonesian government bonds, publicly listed company shares, or bank savings/deposits.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying investment.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least USD 2,500,000 (5-year visa) or USD 5,000,000 (10-year visa) invested in establishing a company in Indonesia.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying company investment.

requirement_groups.name: Corporate investor (director/commissioner of an investing company)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires the sponsoring company to have invested at least USD 25,000,000 (5-year visa) or USD 50,000,000 (10-year visa) in Indonesia, with the applicant serving as a director or commissioner of that company.

evidence_required.document: Category-specific investment documentation (bond/share certificates, deposit statement, or company incorporation/investment records)

outcome.duration_length: 5 or 10 years depending on tier chosen, extendable

sources.title: Direktorat Jenderal Imigrasi eVisa portal -- Golden Visa FAQ: up to 5-year (extendable) duration, no employment, family can join, study permitted
Ashtara (legal analysis) -- Golden Visa investment tiers under Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023 and PMK No. 82 of 2023: three investor categories x two duration tiers each

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Indonesia's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: the tier-1 eVisa FAQ described a single IDR 2,000,000,000 (~USD 130,000) minimum bank-account figure and only a 5-year duration under the 'Golden Visa' FAQ entry -- this does NOT match the much higher, tiered thresholds (USD 350,000 up to USD 50,000,000) confirmed by the tier-3 legal-analysis source citing the actual regulations (Permenkumham 22/2023, PMK 82/2023) by number. Given how large this discrepancy is, it seems most likely the eVisa FAQ's IDR 2 billion figure is actually describing the SECOND HOME VISA (see id_second_home_visa, which cites the identical figure) and was mislabelled or cross-listed under the Golden Visa FAQ entry by the eVisa system -- but this is flagged as an inference, not confirmed. THREE GENUINELY DIFFERENT INVESTOR CATEGORIES, each with a 5-year/10-year choice, modelled as OR-logic groups per the regulation-citing tier-3 source.
